mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_code, reservation_slot_id, visit_type_id, visit_type_label, guest_count, staff_memo, summary_headline, slot_label, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationCode}, #{reservationSlotId}, #{visitTypeId}, #{visitTypeLabel}, #{guestCount}, #{staffMemo}, #{summaryHeadline}, #{slotLabel}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_code, reservation_slot_id, visit_type_id, visit_type_label, guest_count, staff_memo, summary_headline, slot_label, created_at, updated_at FROM reservations WHERE reservation_code = #{reservationCode}
